Diagraphies réalisées DANS un puits : do: Logs run IN a well: they give the precise stratigraphic column and the curves (GR, resistivity, density, neutron, sonic). A well always provides them, success or failure. A cheaper stratigraphic survey hole only provides them after a paid log launched separately.
Forage carotté à environ 30 % du prix d': Cored well at about 30 % of the price of a well, which can never produce and gives no information on fluids. It brings back cores; the log and lithology require the survey hole log. Useful to tie the seismic before an expensive well.
Service payant du jeu : un briefing à 8: Paid in-game service: an 8-month briefing and an alert subscription for market events (price shocks, embargo, recession, storm, tax). It only sees part of what is brewing and is sometimes wrong: its track record is shown.
Bouchons de ciment et remise en état du: Cement plugs and site restoration, paid at closure or depletion: 12 % of the drilling cost onshore, 18 % offshore.
Cube sismique avec analyse d'amplitude (: Seismic cube with amplitude analysis (AVO) looking for direct hydrocarbon indicators (bright spots). The best possible information without drilling, but still an estimate.
Échantillon physique du réservoir analys: Physical sample of the reservoir analysed in the laboratory: precise porosity and permeability, the most reliable data but also the most expensive.
Analyse de laboratoire sur des échantill: Laboratory analysis of source rock samples: measures TOC (total organic carbon), hydrogen index (HI) and Tmax, to directly assess generative potential and maturity, independently of the paleo-burial calculation.
Loi d'Archie avec a = 1, m = n = 2, util: Archie's law with a = 1, m = n = 2, used as is in the logs and saturation calculations.
φ = (ρma − ρb) / (ρma − ρf). Un neutron: φ = (ρma − ρb) / (ρma − ρf). A neutron reading clearly below density porosity signals gas.
Tmax sous 435 °C : immature ; de 435 à 4: Tmax below 435 °C: immature; from 435 to 455 °C: oil window; above: gas. HI starts from a value specific to the kerogen type (I lacustrine, II marine, III coal) then falls with maturity.
Gradient de fracturation d'Eaton, résist: Eaton fracture gradient, rock strength derived from the sonic (McNally correlation), circulation lag (bottoms-up), kicks, losses and stuck pipe: real mechanisms.
Z = ρ·v et R = (Z2 − Z1) / (Z2 + Z1) fix: Z = ρ·v and R = (Z2 − Z1) / (Z2 + Z1) set the polarity (blue: increase, red: decrease) and the strength of the reflectors.
Courbe de déclin hyperbolique, de type A: Hyperbolic decline curve, Arps type, for each well.
Elle dépend de la température au plus fo: It depends on the temperature at maximum burial, with no thermal history or kinetics (no vitrinite reflectance computed). The dry-gas generation coefficient is plausible, not measured.
La charge décroît avec la distance à la: Charge decreases with distance from the kitchen: no carrier beds, no buoyancy, no leak points. The charging of a reservoir by a shallow source rock at the contact of a fault is a qualitative rule.
Des traits colorés à la place d'ondelett: Coloured lines instead of wavelets: no convolution, no real time domain, a single simplified noise level.
Capteurs GR à 12 m et Rt à 6 m derrière: GR sensors 12 m and Rt 6 m behind the tool, inclination limited to 2° per 10 m: realistic orders of magnitude on a trajectory simplified to two dimensions.
12 % (terre) et 18 % (mer) du coût de fo: 12 % (onshore) and 18 % (offshore) of the drilling cost: an order of magnitude. Offshore, the abandonment of a field can exceed the cost of drilling it.
Les 9 et 11 Ω·m du jeu valent dans le je: The game's 9 and 11 Ω·m hold within the game. In the field, the threshold depends on formation water (Rw), porosity and lithology.
Étalonnées pour l'équilibre du jeu (moye: Calibrated for game balance (average around 24 %). A map's richness is relative to the game's generator, not to real basins.
Embargo, récession, tempête, taxe except: Embargo, recession, storm, extraordinary tax: realistic categories, but invented frequencies and magnitudes.
Détection de 75 à 80 % et fausses alerte: Detection of 75 to 80 % and false alarms: game rules to create a gamble, not real statistics.
Les causes (argile, coude serré, outil u: The causes (clay, tight bend, worn tool, fault) are realistic; the probabilities are tuned for the game.
Sondage et diagraphie payés à part: Survey hole and log paid separately
Sur un chantier réel, la diagraphie fait: On a real site, the log is part of the drilling budget. It is separated here to make it a choice.

    seismic survey or a log on the promising blocks, then drill once the trap, reservoir, seal and
